CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   C. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   D. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   B. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

7. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)

   D. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.

9. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

10. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

11. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

12. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   B. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Netball.

13. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)

   B. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming.

14. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

15. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Photography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts Works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The number  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
